entities.summary: Navaratna Srinivasa Rajaram was an Indian academic at University of Indiana, scholar and NASA scientist. He is notable for propounding the "Indigenous Aryans" hypothesis, asserting that the Vedic period was extremely advanced from a scientific view-point, and claiming of having deciphered the Indus script. Academics find his scholarship to be composed of dishonest polemics in service of a communal agenda.
